subject: PO serialization & invoice cutoff — NovaMed procurement
messages:
From: Sara Lim <sara.lim@novamed.com>

Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 14 Jul 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: PO serialization & invoice cadence questions

Hi Markus / Vanessa,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the NovaMed procurement team had a couple of follow-ups as we prepare the PO:

1) PO serialization: our ERP creates one PO per legal entity and then serializes line items across multiple GL entities. We need Redwood to accept invoice lines that reference a parent PO and an additional PO_serial field (e.g., PO-12345 / PO-12345-ENT2). Can you confirm the billing system supports sending/receiving that additional PO_serial identifier so our AP team can auto-apply?

2) Invoice cadence & cutoff: we prefer weekly invoices but our AR system only pulls invoices generated before close-of-business Friday (5pm PST) for bank processing. Any invoices generated after that must be included in the next week. Is there a hard weekend cutoff / timezone rule we should be aware of?

3) Partial invoicing: we will occasionally request partial invoicing against a single PO when milestones are achieved across entities. Is there a limit or preferred format so you can link multiple invoice numbers back to the originating PO?

4) Net terms: NovaMed standard is Net60; we understand Redwood's public tiers are Net30. Please outline any discount/pricing adjustments for Net60 and whether early-pay discounts are available.

If helpful, I attached our standard PO export spec and a sample PO (see attachment). We need to finalize before routing to legal — could you confirm by end of week?

Thanks,
Sara
Sara Lim
Senior Procurement Manager
NovaMed Health Systems
procurement@novamed.com

Subject: Re: PO serialization & invoice cadence questions

Hi Sara — thanks for the clear spec and the sample PO. Looping in Vanessa and Karthik to align on pricing and ops. Summary answers below and a couple of asks so we can map this into your ERP cleanly.

1) PO_serial / secondary identifier: Yes — Redwood billing accepts an additional free-text PO_reference field and can persist it to invoices. Best practice: provide the parent PO in the standard PONumber field and the entity-specific token in PO_reference (e.g., PO-12345 | PO-12345-ENT2). We'll include both fields on the invoice PDF and in the AP-export CSV.

2) Weekly invoice & Friday cutoff: We can schedule weekly invoices and honor a Friday 17:00 PST cutoff. Invoices generated after 17:00 Friday will be rolled to the following week's run. Important: our invoice-generation job runs in the UTC timezone for hosted accounts; we'll configure your billing profile to use 17:00 PST as the authoritative cutoff for NovaMed. Please confirm the timezone label so we can lock it in.

3) Partial invoicing / linking: We support partial invoices tied to the same PONumber. To ensure automated matching on your side, include the PO_serial in the invoice line and set the Invoice.Reference field to the parent PO. We'll also populate Invoice.RelatedInvoiceIds when invoice is a partial (e.g., INV-1001 references INV-0998). If you can provide examples of how your AP expects the CSV column names, we'll adapt the export.

4) Net60 & pricing: Standard hosted terms are Net30. For Net60 we can extend terms but it will affect unit price. As a starting point, we can offer either: (A) 4% uplift on price for Net60 (to offset AR risk), or (B) keep list price and provide a 1% early-pay discount if paid within 15 days. Vanessa, could you propose the discount clause that preserves margin?

Next steps: I attached a PO-to-invoice mapping template (PO-mapping-template.csv) — please populate the column headers with your ERP field names and return. Also confirm whether you need consolidated monthly statements in addition to weekly invoices.

Markus
Markus Klein
Head of Sales Engineering | Redwood Inference
markus_klein@redwood.com

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: PO serialization & invoice cadence questions

Hi Sara, Markus — quick note on the commercial side. I reviewed NovaMed's expected Net60 request with Finance. Options we can consider: 

- Option 1 (preferred for NovaMed): Maintain list price, provide 1.5% early-pay discount if payment arrives within 20 days. This is easier for reconciliation and keeps the billed amount predictable.
- Option 2: Apply a tiered surcharge for Net60: 3% uplift on the invoice for invoices with Net60 terms.

Given NovaMed's size and strategic fit, I'm inclined to offer Option 1 for the first 12 months of the contract, then re-evaluate. That keeps procurement happy while protecting our AR exposure. We can encode the early-pay discount on invoice lines so your ERP can pick it up automatically.

On the operational ask: we will add the PO_reference and RelatedInvoiceIds to the CSV export. Markus — we'll also include an 'InvoiceCutoffLocalTime' flag in the billing profile for NovaMed to ensure Friday 17:00 PST is enforced.

If that works for you Sara, I'll draft a short commercial amendment to the SOW/Order that states: "NovaMed invoices on weekly cadence, Friday 17:00 PST cutoff; early-pay discount 1.5% if paid within 20 days; Redwood to support PO_serial mapping fields as specified." I can route the amendment for e-signature.

-Vanessa
Vanessa Ortiz
Director, Customer Success | Redwood Inference

Thanks — that all looks good. Confirming:

- We'll populate your PO-mapping-template.csv with our ERP header names and return by EOD Monday.
- Weekly invoices with Friday 17:00 PST cutoff are acceptable.
- We accept the 1.5% early-pay discount if paid within 20 days (Net60 remains the default). Please include the discount clause in the amendment.
- Please include the PO_serial in the invoice CSV as PO_reference and on the PDF visual.

One last operational ask: our banking batch cut runs Saturday morning, so any invoices included in the Friday run must be finalized (no manual edits) by Friday 17:00 PST. Can you add the Invoice.Finalized boolean to the CSV export so we can signal which invoices were in that run?

If you can route the amendment to procurement@novamed.com (and cc me) and include a DocuSign link, we can get legal to sign within 48–72 hours.

Appreciate the fast turn.
Sara
